api.signature: autoRouting({RoutingNets?: string[]|'selected'|'selectedComponents', existingPrimitiveMode?: KEEP, layers?: copperLayerIds[], ...}): Promise<IPCB_AutoRoutingResult>
api.note: Installed implementation reads case-sensitive RoutingNets; examples using nets are wrong. KEEP='keep', REMOVE='remove'. Never clear all routing. Restrict to affected nets/layers; not a preservation guarantee. No global autoLayout because its API has no subset parameter.
